full_judgment: The Ministry of Education published a circular containing an amendment Nitimala vide Memo No. শিম/শা-১৩/এমপিও নীতিমালা সংশোধন/২০১২/৮৭ তারিখ ২৪/০৩/২০১৩ stating provision that the Lecturers attaining eight years in service from M.P.O shall be entitled to be promoted as Assistant Professor provided that those Lecturers having qualification at the time of their appointment under the then rules will also be qualified to be promoted. That the petitioners are seniors in their College among the Lecturers and they are entitled to be promoted as Assistant Professors according to ratio 5:2 under amended Nitimala as published in 2013 and the governing body is legally liable to recommended their names as Assistant Professors but instead of that the governing body of the College vide their resolution in the meeting held on 20.07.2012 recommended the name of three others Lecturers who are junior to the petitioners before the respondent No. 2.
